name: impact-success-case-write-up
description: Writes up success cases from interview notes you already hold, producing the selection rule with its counts, anonymous write-ups of uses that worked and uses that stalled with the evidence checked for each, and a barrier list naming the role that could remove each barrier. Use for "run impact-success-case-write-up", "success case method", "evidence the training was used", "what got in the way after training", "write up the learner interviews", "did anyone actually use the training", "stories of use on the job", "show impact without a money figure", part of the Claude Guide for Training Impact Pack by 90n.
